researchQuestion: After the exact current card-score selector fails policy capacity, what is the minimum non-adaptive scientific intervention that can measure whether the two existing acquired consumers activate with the same policies and seeds, without pretending that activation or policy-method decision value has already been observed?
competingOptions: retune the closed current card-score selector or cardDecline threshold
introduce one exogenous deterministic existing-consumer acquisition factor for controlled research assignment only
introduce a new policy method, ML, RL or optimiser
assign packages randomly or by policy hash
change content, payoff or carrier before testing the existing exact consumers
claimBoundary: This zero-row audit may select one minimum experimental factor for a separate implementation-identity preflight. It cannot establish policy choice, activation, complementarity, causal benefit, functional separation, method decision value, candidate admission, product scope or shipping fitness, and it cannot run Godot, inspect support or create a simulator row.

classificationRules.selectorClosure: A mechanical-green capacity result with sparse Warden's Edge choice and no Warden's Edge viable policy closes the exact score selector rather than authorising retune.
classificationRules.minimumExperimentalIntervention: When null identity, direct one-card mediator, no-RNG and existing save representation are exact, independently assigning either existing consumer or off is smaller than changing a score, threshold, content, payoff, carrier or policy method.
classificationRules.methodDecisionValue: ML, RL or another optimiser requires enabled activation or comparable causal evidence showing that a new policy method could cross the relevant support and separation gates. A zero-row selection collapse alone is insufficient.
classificationRules.assignmentBoundary: The acquisition factor is an exogenous controlled intervention. It may identify activation capacity but cannot count as policy sensitivity or an autonomous product choice.

decisionRules.success: The exact score selector is mechanically green but closed on sparse Warden's Edge and competent-policy capacity; null identity, one-card direct mediator, no-RNG and existing deck/save representation are exact; no enabled support or causal row supplies policy-method decision value; and the exogenous explicit existing-consumer factor is the sole eligible minimum within the zero-row 20-second budget.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Implement only the research-only duskAcquisitionChoice factor in a new detached exact-current-main source and preregister one implementation-identity protocol. Before a full null panel, deterministic preflight must prove expected cardinality and equality-field invariance; use a cheap sentinel before the full panel. Do not run an enabled whole-run, change content or payoffs, modify BalancePilot, add a policy method, ML, RL, optimiser or use protected seeds before identity passes.
decisionRules.futility: No experimental factor is eligible, more than one is tied, or the explicit factor requires a new ID, save field, payoff, RNG call, policy method or product mutation.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Do not implement or run the factor. Continue inside issue 421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism without reopening the closed selector.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable decision, evidence identity, direct/null prerequisite, task capsule, ledger or 20-second classification cannot be established.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the design inconclusive with no implementation, simulator row or method and use only the current issue-421 authority contract.

methodBoundary: Issues 524 and 525 remain immutable evidence. Deterministic Python owns classification and stop/go. ML, RL, optimisers and opaque policy methods remain prohibited because enabled activation and method decision value are still unmeasured.
